title.narrative: Promoting Mini Grids Based on Small Hydro Power for Productive Uses in Sierra Leone

description.narrative: The overall goal of the project is to remove the institutional, technical, policy and economic barriers to the promotion of small hydro power for productive applications in Sierra Leone and reduce GHG emissions from fossil based power by accelerating the development of small hydro resources. The project aims to develop a market based approach through public private partnerships for promoting small hydro power based mini grids to stimulate productive capacities in the Sierra Leone. To achieve the objective, a 10 MW pilot scale small hydro power based mini grid project is proposed to be set up in the country. In addition, the institutional capacity of stakeholders for project planning and implementation is also being built. The project also aims to develop the local capacity in terms of operation and maintenance of the SHP plants, promoting local manufacturing capacity for SHP components and other productive applications of electricity from the small hydro power plant. The project is expected to bring about a direct reduction of about 499.51 kilotons of CO2 considering its useful life time of 15 years and 848.52 kilotons of CO2 considering a lifetime of 25 years. Additional indirect GHG reductions are also expected through replication SHP projects influenced by the project. UNIDO GEF#s intervention for steering
